section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the analytic strategy for a study examining associations between early positive memories with peers, BMI, self-compassion, social safeness, body appreciation (BAS scale), and disordered eating. Path analyses were conducted using AMOS software to test a theoretical model with direct and indirect effects, employing maximum likelihood estimation with Bootstrap resampling (5000 samples) to assess the significance of mediational paths.
